entities.name: King Solomon
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Third king of Israel (c. 970–931 BCE), renowned for wisdom, wealth, and the construction of the First Temple in Jerusalem. Author/compiler of Proverbs, Ecclesiastes, and Song of Solomon. His reign marks Israel's golden age of prosperity and peace, but his later apostasy led to the kingdom's division.
